timing_scope: Three 65,536-byte XOR outputs. Direct Python XOR median uses seven runs before route timing. Route CPU time sums user and system time from the Python host plus reaped FFmpeg children via getrusage at the raw-input-to-byte-output boundary; it excludes the CPU oracle, result comparisons, and the later nvidia-smi query. Stage CPU times are deltas from the same cumulative counter. Negative net_cpu_time_freed_ms means the codec route consumed more CPU. This is one hardware route run in a shared Colab runtime, with no security hardware or concurrent CUDA workload. Results 14 and 15 are separate earlier runs and should not be mixed as one timing sample.
